description: This file contains a collection of shell functions and variables used for configuration management and system operations within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions for manipulating configuration data, managing users and groups, handling package scripts, and various system utilities.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs its arguments if debugging is enabled, using a configurable debug command.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on multiple hex values of the same length.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to a variable, separated by a specified separator.

methods.name: list_contains
methods.description: Checks if a list variable contains a specific string.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data unless within an IPKG instroot.

methods.name: reset_cb
methods.description: Defines no-op callback functions for configuration operations.

methods.name: package
methods.description: Stub function that returns success.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Defines a new configuration section.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Sets an option in the current configuration section.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adds a list item to the current configuration section.

methods.name: config_unset
methods.description: Unsets a configuration option.

methods.name: config_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value with optional default.

methods.name: get_bool
methods.description: Converts a string value to a boolean indicator (1/0).

methods.name: config_get_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration value.

methods.name: config_set
methods.description: Sets a configuration option's value.

methods.name: config_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over configuration sections of a specific type.

methods.name: config_list_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over list items in a specific configuration section.

methods.name: default_prerm
methods.description: Runs pre-removal scripts for a package.

methods.name: add_group_and_user
methods.description: Adds required system groups and users based on package info.

methods.name: default_postinst
methods.description: Runs post-installation scripts for a package, enabling services and setting up environment.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes other shell script files from a specified directory.

methods.name: find_mtd_index
methods.description: Finds the MTD partition index corresponding to a device name.

methods.name: find_mtd_part
methods.description: Returns the device path for an MTD partition.

methods.name: find_mmc_part
methods.description: Finds the device path for an MMC/SD card partition.

methods.name: group_add
methods.description: Adds a group with a specific GID.

methods.name: group_exists
methods.description: Checks if a group exists.

methods.name: group_add_next
methods.description: Adds a group with the next available GID after a check.

methods.name: group_add_user
methods.description: Adds a user to a group.

methods.name: user_add
methods.description: Adds a new user with specific UID and GID.

methods.name: user_exists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists.

methods.name: board_name
methods.description: Retrieves the system's board name.

methods.name: cmdline_get_var
methods.description: Extracts a specific variable's value from /proc/cmdline.
